title: Transforming Maternal Mental Health Care
official: Transforming Maternal Mental Health Care Using Innovative Digital Solutions for the Intermountain West
summary: The overall objective of this pilot study is to assess the feasibility of a RCT comparing Lōvu-augmented with usual prenatal care at UU. This would be a critical next step toward the long-term goal to identify technology-based interventions to improve maternal mental health in the Intermountain West. The investigator's central hypothesis is that Lōvu will be both feasible and have high patient and clinician satisfaction, and that Lōvu-generated data will be a promising substrate for AI-based mental health risk stratification.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Pregnant people receiving care at University of Utah Clinics
* Less than 14 weeks gestation at enrollment

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients enrolled in other studies utilizing remote monitoring
